tasks.description: Make the agent actually use tools and LLM in a real scenario. Ensure tool results flow back into the planner, LLM responses are stored in state, the planner can chain multiple steps, and the loop can run 5–20 cycles without stalling.
tasks.details: This is a full integration test of the Unified Agent Runtime. The goal is to have a working multi-step agent that: 1) Uses tools and receives results, 2) Uses LLM calls and stores responses, 3) Chains multiple decisions, 4) Reaches a FinalAnswer after several cycles.

tasks.description: Add a structured tracing system to the Unified Agent Runtime Loop so each planner decision, LLM call, tool call, and state update is captured in a RuntimeTrace. Provide optional CLI output for step-by-step visualization.
tasks.details: Introduce a RuntimeTrace struct that records each cycle of the agent loop, including planner decisions, LLM prompts/responses, tool calls/results, and state deltas. Add a --trace flag to the CLI to print a human-readable step-by-step execution log. Ensure tracing is optional and does not affect runtime behavior.

Implement pretty-printer for trace output

tasks.title: Runtime Trace Logging + Step Visualization
Tool Supervisor v2: Validation + Retry + Error Classification
tasks.description: Upgrade the Tool Supervisor to validate tool arguments, classify tool errors, retry failed calls when appropriate, and provide structured feedback to the planner. This improves reliability and prevents the agent from stalling or hallucinating when tools fail.
tasks.details: Introduce a ToolSupervisorV2 that wraps all tool calls with validation, structured error handling, and retry logic. Add a ToolError enum with categories (InvalidArgs, ExecutionError, NotFound, RateLimit, Unknown). Add a ToolResult enum that includes success, retryable failure, and fatal failure. Integrate this into the runtime loop so PlannerOutput::ToolCall receives normalized results.

subtasks.title: Add ToolError enum with classification
subtasks.description: Define ToolError { InvalidArgs, ExecutionError, NotFound, RateLimit, Timeout, Unknown }. Include original error message and optional context.

subtasks.title: Add ToolResult enum
subtasks.description: Define ToolResult { Success(Value), RetryableError(ToolError), FatalError(ToolError) }. This becomes the canonical output of all tool calls.

subtasks.title: Implement ToolSupervisorV2
subtasks.description: Wrap all tool calls with argument validation, error classification, and retry logic. Retry up to N times for RetryableError. Return FatalError for non-retryable cases.

subtasks.title: Integrate ToolSupervisorV2 into runtime loop
subtasks.description: Modify runtime_loop.rs so ToolCall steps use ToolSupervisorV2. Push normalized ToolResult into AgentState and RuntimeTrace.

subtasks.title: Add tests for ToolSupervisorV2
subtasks.description: Unit tests for error classification, retry behavior, and integration with RuntimeLoop.
